entries.title: Matthew 3:1
segments: In those days came John the Baptist preaching in the desert of Judea;

entries.title: Matthew 3:2
segments: "Repent," said he, "for the kingdom of heaven is at hand."

entries.title: Matthew 3:3
segments: This John it was of whom it was said through Isaiah, the prophet, The voice of one who cries aloud in the desert, "Prepare a way for the Lord, Make the paths straight for him."

entries.title: Matthew 3:4
segments: This John wore a garment of camel's hair, and a leather belt around his waist, and his food was locusts and wild honey.

entries.title: Matthew 3:5
segments: Then Jerusalem began to go out to him, and all Judea, and the whole neighborhood of the Jordan,

entries.title: Matthew 3:6
segments: and were baptized by him in the river Jordan, confessing their sins.

entries.title: Matthew 3:7
segments: But when John saw that many of the Pharisees and Sadducees were coming for baptism, he said: "O brood of vipers! Who has warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

entries.title: Matthew 3:8
segments: Then bring forth fruit worthy of repentance.

entries.title: Matthew 3:9
segments: And do not presume to say to yourselves, 'We have Abraham as our father'-I tell you that out of these very stones God is able to raise up descendants for Abraham.

entries.title: Matthew 3:10
segments: And already the axe is lying at the roots of the trees. Any tree, therefore, that does not bear good fruit is cut down and cast into the fire.

entries.title: Matthew 3:11
segments: I indeed am baptizing you in water, unto repentance; but One is coming after me, mightier than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit and in fire.

entries.title: Matthew 3:12
segments: His winnowing-fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse the threshing-floor. He will store his wheat in the granary, but will burn up the chaff in unquenchable fire."

entries.title: Matthew 3:13
segments: At that very time Jesus was on his way from Galilee to the Jordan, to John, to be baptized by him.

entries.title: Matthew 3:14
segments: But he tried to prevent him. "It is I," he said, "who need to be baptized by you, and are you coming to me?"

entries.title: Matthew 3:15
segments: But Jesus answered, "Permit it now, for so it is fitting for us to fulfil every religious duty."

entries.title: Matthew 3:16
segments: Then he consented. And after Jesus was baptized, as soon as he rose out of the water, lo! the heavens opened, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and alighting upon him,

entries.title: Matthew 3:17
segments: while a voice from heaven said, "This is my Son, the Beloved, In whom I delight."
